name: Thomson SPPL 4K Google TV
summary: Thomson SPPL 4K Google TV ships with telemetry, after-sale push and Skyworth ads. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with backup and undo.
intro: This Skyworth-built Thomson 4K TV ships with telemetry and after-sale push services, Android ad and personalisation services, and Skyworth content, ads, demos and preloads. A few apps are also not needed on a TV at all. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

It was applied in batches with a screenshot after each. Live TV, HDMI, YouTube and Hotstar kept working, and after a reboot the list of switched-off apps matched exactly, because this firmware re-enables nothing at boot. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Live TV (the Skyworth live TV app) and HDMI 1 to 3 and AV
The remote's Input, YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video and mic buttons
The main web view and Play Services
notes: The settings button needs a small setting if you use a clean home screen.
The setup wizard owns the saved Wi-Fi network on some sets, so forget and rejoin it first.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Thomson SPPL 4K Google TV?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Will the remote's app buttons still work?
faq.a: Yes. Input, YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video and the mic button all worked in testing.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Thomson SPPL 4K Google TV?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
